title: Efficient and SPAM-Robust Ansatz-Free Lindbladian Learning
summary: Describing the dynamics of open systems is essential for fault-tolerant quantum computation. Under Markovian assumptions, we can characterize dissipative dynamics via the Lindbladian. Using Bell sampling, we provide an efficient, ansatz-free Lindbladian learning algorithm with polynomial-time classical postprocessing.
